prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Waiting screen info enhancements (wait_info) were helpful, winning 3 tests (+5.0%, +5.7%, +4.1%), though 3 tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning 2 tests (+15.4%, +6.4%), though 1 hurt performance (-7.7%) and 3 showed no clear effect.
Reordering steps (reorder) showed no clear effect in 1 test and hurt performance in another (-3.8%).
Copy adjustments, layout changes, redesigns, hints, and notifications showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins (e.g., predicting +3.0% vs +15.4% measured for pet preview, and +4.0% vs +6.4% for sound selection).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +2.5% over 5 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.1% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, reorder: -3.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +4.2% over 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +4.8% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: +0.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, notification: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.3% over 6 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.2% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.6% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Changes:
0: [home, wait_info] Interactive Companion Animation Simulator on Waiting Screen: Add an interactive animation playback module to the waiting screen where users can click to test desktop pet reactions while generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), causing dropoffs during background processing.)
1: [home, notification] Background Pet Render Audio Chime Alert: Enable an automated sound chime and system visual alert when the background rendering completes on the waiting screen. (why: Mean time spent on the waiting screen is over 38 minutes (2336s), indicating users switch windows and miss when generation finishes.)
2: [finish, copy] Desktop Visibility Quick Toggle Instructions: Update the final intro text with explicit instructions on how to bring the pet back if hidden behind full-screen windows. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting pet missing from desktop or app not appearing on screen post-onboarding.)
3: [sign_in, layout] Compact Account Persistence Options Layout: Switch sign-in screen to a compact layout with explicit indicators showing which login method holds existing pet data. (why: Users frequently sign in with alternate credentials resulting in account reset confusion (8 support tickets).)

scores.note: Wait_info changes have strong historical performance (+3.3% avg across 6 tests), though building an interactive simulator requires custom code and target step dropoff is relatively low (10.5%).
Notifications showed no clear effect across tests and scored -1.4% on home step previously; lacks support email backing.
Strong funnel evidence (finish step drops 35.2%) and direct support mail alignment (3 tickets), easy config/copy fix, though copy tweaks historically yield modest gains.
Supported by both 27.1% dropoff funnel data and 8 support tickets, but layout adjustments have shown no clear benefit (-1.4% previously).
